name: Yukimi Kakigori
description: Yukimi Kakigori — a kakigori shaved-ice parlour theme built on sticky media: on wide screens the picture column holds still while the text column scrolls past it (the menu, the four bowl rows, the story band and the parlour page). A formal top header, centred: the parlour name and tagline in the middle of the first row, the menu centred on the second row and the Reserve a seat button at the right end; an overlay menu on phones and tablets. Rikyū-nezumi, the quiet grey sage-green of traditional Japanese dyeing (#8F9B84), is the main colour: the hero, the story band, every page head and the overlay menu are solid sage fields set in deep green ink, on a cream ground with pale matcha-mist panels and deep matcha links; the red of the strawberry bowl is the only bright note. The hero is a product grid: the title, lead, buttons and today's ice on the left, four paper-cut bowls as a taped, slightly tilted 2 x 2 collage on the right, and a cut-out bowl of strawberry ice (transparent WebP) standing in front of the grid and breaking over the hero bottom edge; a cut-out plover flag breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a layered paper-cut illustration in a torn, taped paper collage. Darumadrop One for display, Rubik for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: v1.0.1 recolour (2026-10-17): the main colour is now rikyū-nezumi grey sage-green #8F9B84 with deep green ink, a cream ground and matcha-mist panels, for a calmer, more refined look; the sample garden is now a tea-bush garden, and eight pictures were regenerated in the new palette. Otherwise built to design-plan.json row b4-8 (sticky-media, product-grid-hero, centered nav, collage, paper-cut, Darumadrop One + Rubik, food-drink). A formal top header with the parlour name, a centred menu row and the Reserve a seat button. Sticky media on wide screens: the menu intro and ice-block picture, each bowl picture on The menu, the story collage and the parlour picture hold still while the text scrolls. Break-frame: the cut-out bowl breaks over the hero bottom edge and the cut-out plover flag over the story band and page heads.

summary.zh-TW: 利休鼠灰綠的刨冰店：拼貼剪紙商品格狀主視覺、去背刨冰破格而出、置中選單、圖文並排的固定圖片欄，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A rikyu-nezumi sage kakigori parlour: a paper-cut product grid hero, a cut-out bowl breaking out and sticky picture columns.
summary.ja: 利休鼠色のかき氷店。切り絵の商品グリッド、枠を越える切り抜きの氷、中央のメニュー、止まる画像列。
summary.fr: Un salon de kakigori vert sauge grisé : grille de bols en papier découpé, bol détouré qui déborde, images fixes au défilement.
summary.de: Ein salbeigrauer Kakigori-Salon: Scherenschnitt-Raster im Hero, freigestellte Schale bricht aus, stehende Bildspalten.
